summary.name: DEAN HUSAIN
summary.title: Systems & Network Specialist
summary.description: Computer Science graduate specializing in Network Security with hands-on experience in Layer 1–3 networking, network infrastructure, Linux/Windows administration, container networking, and technical support. Built and troubleshot segmented firmware, and supported physical network infrastructure. Additional experience building Linux-based GPU/AI workloads and isolated container environments with hands-on systems administration and networking.

education.degree: Bachelor of Science in Computer Science (Network Security Concentration)

projects.title: Infrastructure & Network Security Deployment
bullets: Redesigned a previously flat home network supporting approximately 60 devices, including laptops, phones, smart TVs, IoT devices, smart switches, and security cameras
Replaced stock firmware on multiple Google Nest routers with OpenWrt and deployed an 802.1Q VLAN architecture separating Management, IoT, Guest, and Security traffic into distinct broadcast domains
Configured firewall zones and inter-VLAN access policies to restrict unnecessary device-to-device communication while preserving required administrative access over SSH and HTTPS.
Isolated security camera infrastructure from general household and IoT devices, addressing previously unrestricted access to DVR resources and unintended cross-device discovery and casting.
Configured a managed Netgear GS308E switch with tagged trunk and untagged access ports, extending VLAN segmentation across wireless access points and wired infrastructure.

Used Wireshark to validate VLAN isolation before and after segmentation; Management VLAN captures showed that traffic from other broadcast domains was no longer directly visible after segmentation, while permitted outbound traffic remained observable.
Provisioned static DHCP leases for self-hosted services including Pi-hole, Home Assistant, and DVR infrastructure, establishing predictable addressing for network services.

projects.title: Self-Hosted & Air-Gapped Container Architecture
bullets: Migrated a GPU-accelerated AI workload from Windows to Linux, configuring NVIDIA drivers and Container Device Interface (CDI)-based GPU device exposure for rootless Podman containers in a headless, CLI-driven environment.
Built custom container images and Containerfiles rather than relying on unverified third-party images, creating reproducible deployment environments under controlled configurations.

Architected separate network-connected and air-gapped container environments, allowing workloads to retain required GPU, storage, and host resources while restricting unnecessary LAN and Internet access.

Implemented container network isolation using a custom host-only virtual network interface, preventing offline workloads from accessing external networks while maintaining required host-to-container communication.
Designed persistent host-mounted storage for multi-gigabyte AI models and datasets, using read-only mounts where appropriate to protect source data across container lifecycles.
Built reproducible container environments using Podman, Docker images, and custom Containerfiles, enabling consistent deployment and preservation of pre-configured workloads.

experience.title: Systems & Network Specialist
bullets: Performed Layer 1–2 physical infrastructure installs for clients, including structured low-voltage cabling, coax/BNC termination, and media converter setups.
Provisioned, configured, and deployed end-user workstation hardware, managing operating system installations, software baselines, and peripheral integration.
Delivered Tier 2 remote technical support and endpoint troubleshooting via TeamViewer and RDP, resolving OS-level errors, driver conflicts, and software bugs.
Deployed IP and analog CCTV security systems, configuring NVR/DVR storage units, local IP assignment, and remote monitoring access for clients.
Performed deep system diagnostics, malware remediation, and hardware bench repairs to restore performance and safeguard client data integrity.

experience.title: Web-Design Intern
bullets: Collaborated in weekly refinement sessions to translate layout mind maps into a fully functional multi-page site using Webflow.
Engineered and tested responsive breakpoints and alignment configurations for mobile and desktop devices.
Prototyped high-fidelity landing page animations using Adobe After Effects and integrated Lottie files for performance optimization.
Applied core HTML/CSS principles within visual development environments to enforce clean frontend layouts.
